$comment: Templates and index sources that OpenTierBoy refuses (docs/reference/template-indices.md). "files" lists SHA-256 checksums of template files, as 64 lowercase hex characters. "sources" lists sources in lowercase, as the app shows them: github.com/owner/repository, gist.github.com/id, or a host. A source blocks every index and every template file at that source. An entry takes effect for everybody with the next deployment.
